systems.system: Integrated Population and Secure Documents Management System (SIGPTS)
systems.tiers: national; used in a World Bank-funded pilot in N'Djamena to issue refugee identification numbers, more than 4,000 as of 2025-05-01

note: Refugee identity documents issued through ANATS's system; 'local authorities' appear only as bodies that did not recognise earlier credentials. Nothing on local government offices' connection.
